description: Score every dependency in a manifest or lock file and list the riskiest first. Supports package.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, and the lock files package-lock.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, poetry.lock and uv.lock (which include transitive dependencies). GitHub-hosted dependencies are scored as repositories. Prefer `path` for local files, especially large lock files; otherwise pass `content`. Use to audit a project's dependencies for abandoned or risky packages.

content.description: Full text of the manifest file, if not passing `path`

filename.description: File name for `content`, used to detect the format (e.g. package.json, yarn.lock)

max_packages.description: Upper limit on packages scored; lock files often list several hundred

path.description: Path to a local manifest or lock file, relative to the server's working directory. One of: package.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, package-lock.json, npm-shrinkwrap.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, poetry.lock, uv.lock, requirements*.txt

name: scan_manifest
title: Scan dependency manifest
